title: Squeaky, heavy, looks good.
text:
Squeaky, heavy, looks good.. Beautiful mirror that is clear, and the hardware is a up to date style.
Very good looking.

Went to hang it , and I was shocked that the smaller Arm is VERY Hard to move, and Squeaky.
The small arm that is squeaky, is so hard to move, If I move it while it's hanging attached to the wall, it will pull the little plastic
fasteners out of the wall!..

This is put together so tight, I don't see how it can be sprayed with WD40!.
Ok, I'm not handy, and would not attempt to take it apart to spray it, and I should not have to struggle with
this mirror..It is suppose to more easy, and Not squeak.

The only way this can be hang is to put it into a stud on the wall, and leave both arms
laying flat against the wall.
When I use this, I have to pull the large arm forward, and stand back, so I don't get hit in the face.
The mirror it self swivels , and the mirror goes from magnifying, to a regular mirror but like I said, the small arm does not move.

I Would Not buy this..
